answer: The fatigue crack started at hole LC-1. diagnosis: Fatigue crack originated at hole LC-1.
recommended_actions: Inspect the area around hole LC-1 for any signs of fatigue or overstress.
Perform a thorough inspection of similar components on the aircraft to ensure no other fatigue cracks exist.
Consider conducting additional non-destructive testing (NDT) to assess the integrity of the spar caps.
